d:
Long, flowing platinum white hair with blunt-cut bangs and a silky texture. Soft lavender eyes with a gentle, innocent expression. Apparent age of a young teenager with a soft, youthful face. Slender, petite build. A traditional Japanese-style outfit featuring a white and light blue kimono with wide sleeves and a red obi sash. Signature details include a large, fluffy white fox tail and two matching white fox ears atop the head.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
